title: Cyber experts say the EU's age verification app has glaring privacy and security problems; after saying it was ready, EU officials say the app is a "demo" (Politico)
summary: Politico: Cyber experts say the EU's age verification app has glaring privacy and security problems; after saying it was ready, EU officials say the app is a “demo” — BRUSSELS — The European Union's unveiling of a mobile app to check people's age online has quickly turned sour …
